answer: One concrete defense is a locked identity bond with delayed payouts. Before an agent can earn, it must dock a deposit at a metaphorical jetty and leave that stake sitting in a sable-dark vault. Rewards then trickle only from a slow oasis that unlocks after a clean history. To spin up a thousand fake names, an attacker has to lock a full bond for every identity and forgo that capital for the whole delay window; if the fakes collude or spam, the bonds are slashed, so the attack cost scales linearly and is not recoverable.
